definitions.note: future tense (he/she/it will)
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Resterà a casa stasera.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He/She will stay at home tonight.

definitions.native: I will stay, I will remain
definitions.note: future tense (io) of "restare".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Resterò a casa stasera.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I will stay at home tonight.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: È importante che io resti calmo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: It’s important that I stay calm.

definitions.note: Often means “we stay” (remain in a place or situation), not “we rest.”
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Restiamo a casa stasera.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: We’re staying at home tonight.

definitions.note: Subjunctive form (used after expressions like "spero che...", "è importante che...").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Spero che restino qui fino a domani.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I hope they stay here until tomorrow.

definitions.note: Often used for returning something that was borrowed, or giving something back to its owner.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Devo restituire questo libro in biblioteca domani.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have to return this book to the library tomorrow.

definitions.note: Used with money or favors/debts.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ti restituirò i soldi la prossima settimana.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’ll pay you back the money next week.

definitions.note: Used in the present subjunctive (e.g. after expressions like “spero che…”) and also as the formal imperative (Lei form).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Spero che mi restituisca il libro domani.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I hope you return the book to me tomorrow.

definitions.note: Used for the 2nd person plural (“you all”) in the present tense and also for the 2nd person plural imperative (“return!”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Restituite le chiavi alla reception, per favore.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Return the keys to the front desk, please.

definitions.note: past participle of "restituire"; often used with "essere" (e.g., "è stato restituito")
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Il portafoglio è stato restituito al proprietario.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The wallet was returned to its owner.

definitions.note: Past historic (passato remoto), 3rd person singular (he/she/it).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mi restituì i soldi il giorno dopo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He gave me the money back the next day.

definitions.note: Often used to mean “I’ll stay” or “I’m staying” in context.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Stasera resto a casa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Tonight I’m staying at home.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Il resto della pizza è nel frigo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The rest of the pizza is in the fridge.

definitions.note: Used for the money you get back after paying.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Scusi, il resto, per favore.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Excuse me, the change, please.

definitions.note: past historic (passato remoto) of “restare”; common in writing and in some regions, less in everyday speech (which often uses passato prossimo).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo la cena, restò a casa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After dinner, he/she stayed at home.

definitions.note: Most commonly refers to a physical net (e.g., for fishing or sports).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Il pesce è rimasto nella rete.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The fish got stuck in the net.

definitions.note: Used for systems of connected things (e.g., computer networks, transport networks).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La rete Wi‑Fi qui è molto veloce.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The Wi‑Fi network here is very fast.

definitions.note: Often used in formal/work contexts; closer to “compensation” than everyday “stipendio.”
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La retribuzione dipende dall’esperienza e dalle responsabilità.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Pay depends on experience and responsibilities.

definitions.note: As a noun, it means the back side of something (e.g., a card, a photo, a shirt). Not the English adjective “retro” (old-fashioned style).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Sul retro della foto c’è una data.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: On the back of the photo there’s a date.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: I rettili amano stare al sole.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Reptiles like to stay in the sun.

definitions.native: ri (solfège syllable for D-sharp / raised re)
definitions.note: Used in chromatic solfège (movable Do). In standard Italian note names, you usually see do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, si.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Nel solfeggio cromatico, dopo re viene ri.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: In chromatic solfège, after re comes ri.

definitions.note: Non-standard/dialectal clitic pronoun (often in southern/colloquial Italian); in standard Italian this is usually expressed with "gli" (to them).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ri ho detto la verità.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I told them the truth.

definitions.note: Often written with an accent as “rì” in standard Italian (past historic, 3rd person singular of “ridere”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Appena lo vide, ri.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: As soon as he saw him, he laughed.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Puoi scrivere un riassunto del capitolo?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Can you write a summary of the chapter?

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho riattaccato dopo la chiamata.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I hung up after the call.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho riattaccato il cavo al computer.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I reattached the cable to the computer.

definitions.note: Often used for restarting a computer, phone, or system.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Devo riavviare il computer perché si è bloccato.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have to restart the computer because it froze.

definitions.note: Can be used as an adjective or as a noun (a rebel).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Era un ragazzo ribelle e non seguiva mai le regole.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He was a rebellious boy and he never followed the rules.

definitions.note: past participle of "ricaricare"; often used with "avere" to form past tenses
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho ricaricato il telefono prima di uscire.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I recharged my phone before going out.

definitions.note: feminine singular form of "ricco".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mia zia è ricca.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: My aunt is rich.

definitions.note: feminine plural form
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Quelle famiglie sono molto ricche.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Those families are very rich.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La ricchezza non garantisce la felicità.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Wealth doesn’t guarantee happiness.

definitions.note: plural masculine form of “ricco”
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: I ricchi abitano spesso in quartieri costosi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Rich people often live in expensive neighborhoods.

definitions.note: plural noun; often used with an article (e.g., "i ricchi")
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: I ricchi pagano più tasse.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Rich people pay more taxes.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: I ricci vivono nei boschi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Hedgehogs live in the woods.

definitions.note: Usually refers to curls of hair.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Lei ha i ricci naturali.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She has natural curls.

definitions.note: Often used to mean a curl of hair; it can also refer to a hedgehog, but this meaning depends on context.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho un riccio ribelle che non vuole stare a posto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have a stubborn curl that won’t stay in place.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Quel signore è molto ricco.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: That man is very rich.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La ricerca scientifica richiede tempo e pazienza.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Scientific research requires time and patience.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Sono in ricerca di un nuovo lavoro.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I am looking for a new job.

definitions.note: Often used for someone wanted by the police.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: È un uomo ricercato.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He is a wanted man.

definitions.note: Used for tastes, style, or places; not the same as English "researched."
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: È un ristorante molto ricercato.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: It’s a very refined restaurant.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Questa ricetta è facile da preparare.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This recipe is easy to make.

definitions.note: Used especially for a doctor’s prescription.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Il medico mi ha fatto una ricetta per l’antibiotico.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The doctor wrote me a prescription for the antibiotic.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho provato due ricette nuove questo weekend.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I tried two new recipes this weekend.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Lei riceve molti messaggi ogni giorno.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She receives a lot of messages every day.

definitions.note: first-person plural ("we") in the passato remoto (remote past), often used in written Italian or storytelling
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ieri ricevemmo una lettera importante.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Yesterday we received an important letter.

definitions.note: Often used for receiving something delivered, given, or sent (a letter, a gift, a call, etc.).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho ricevuto una lettera da mia nonna.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I received a letter from my grandma.

definitions.note: Future tense; plural “you” (voi).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Riceverete un'email con tutti i dettagli domani.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: You will receive an email with all the details tomorrow.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Domani riceverà una email importante.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Tomorrow, they will receive an important email.

definitions.note: past historic (passato remoto), 3rd person singular
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ieri ricevette una lettera importante.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Yesterday he received an important letter.

definitions.note: Past historic (passato remoto), 1st person singular.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ieri ricevetti una lettera da mia nonna.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Yesterday I received a letter from my grandma.

definitions.note: Also commonly means “receipt/acknowledgement” (proof that something was received or paid).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Hai la ricevuta del pagamento?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Do you have the receipt for the payment?

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho ricevuto la tua email.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I received your email.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ti richiamo più tardi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’ll call you back later.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Questa canzone mi richiama alla mente l’estate.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This song brings summer back to my mind.

definitions.note: Often used for calling someone to come back/come over (e.g., an employee, student, dog).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Il capo mi ha richiamato in ufficio.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: My boss called me back to the office.

definitions.native: call her back, call her again
definitions.note: Includes the direct object pronoun “la” (= her, or it referring to a feminine noun).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Devo richiamarla più tardi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have to call her back later.

definitions.native: call him back, call it back
definitions.note: Infinitive + attached direct object pronoun “lo” (“him/it”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Devo richiamarlo più tardi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have to call him back later.

definitions.note: Used with the object pronoun "mi" (= me) attached to the verb.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Puoi richiamarmi più tardi?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Can you call me back later?

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La cliente è stata richiamata nel pomeriggio.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The customer was called back in the afternoon.

definitions.note: Imperative addressed to "you" plural (voi) + "me" (mi). Often used to ask someone to phone you again.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Se non rispondo, richiamatemi più tardi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: If I don’t answer, call me back later.

definitions.note: past participle of "richiamare"; often used in passive forms (e.g., "sono stato richiamato" = "I was called back/recalled").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Sono stato richiamato dal mio capo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I was called back by my boss.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Non posso parlare adesso: ti richiamerà più tardi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I can't talk now: he/she will call you back later.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Non richiamerà mai quel momento senza emozionarsi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He/she will never recall that moment without getting emotional.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mi richiami dopo pranzo?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Can you call me back after lunch?

definitions.note: From the verb "richiamare"; this form is most commonly "(io) richiamo" = "I call/call back".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ti richiamo più tardi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’ll call you back later.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo l’errore, l’allenatore lo richiamò in panchina.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After the mistake, the coach called him back to the bench.

definitions.note: Third-person singular ("he/she/it" or "you" formal) of "richiedere".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Questo lavoro richiede molta pazienza.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This job requires a lot of patience.

definitions.note: Often used in formal contexts (e.g., documents, procedures).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Per ottenere il visto, devi richiedere un appuntamento online.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: To get the visa, you have to request an appointment online.

definitions.note: Often used in formal contexts (e.g., requests, procedures, customer service).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Per completare la registrazione, richiediamo un documento d’identità.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: To complete the registration, we require an ID document.

definitions.note: First-person singular present tense of "richiedere".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Richiedo un rimborso per questo prodotto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I request a refund for this product.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Questi documenti richiedono una firma.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: These documents require a signature.

definitions.note: feminine singular past participle of "richiedere"; used like an adjective to describe something that has been requested
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La documentazione richiesta è completa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The requested documentation is complete.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho inviato una richiesta al servizio clienti.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I sent a request to customer service.

definitions.note: plural of "richiesta".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho ricevuto molte richieste di informazioni.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I received many requests for information.

definitions.note: past participle used in the plural; often means “requested” in contexts like documents or information, and “required” in contexts like requirements.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Per completare la domanda, carica tutti i documenti richiesti.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: To complete the application, upload all the required documents.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Per aprire il conto, mi hanno richiesto un documento d’identità.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: To open the account, they requested an ID document from me.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Questa carta è riciclata.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This paper is recycled.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo la pausa, dobbiamo ricominciare a lavorare.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After the break, we have to start working again.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Se non ti piace, puoi ricomprare quello che avevi prima.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: If you don’t like it, you can buy again what you had before.

definitions.note: Simple past (passato remoto), 3rd person singular of “riconoscere”; common in narration and writing.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Quando mi vide, mi riconobbe subito.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: When he saw me, he recognized me right away.

definitions.note: simple past (passato remoto), 3rd person plural
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Lo riconobbero subito dalla voce.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They recognized him immediately by his voice.

definitions.note: past historic (passato remoto), 1st person singular
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Lo riconobbi subito dalla voce.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I recognized him right away by his voice.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Lui riconosce la sua voce.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He recognizes her voice.

definitions.note: Often used with “essere” (e.g., “sono riconoscente”) and commonly followed by “a” (to someone) or “per” (for something).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Sono molto riconoscente per il tuo aiuto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m very grateful for your help.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Non ti riconosco con questi occhiali.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I don’t recognize you with those glasses.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ha riconosciuto di aver sbagliato.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He admitted that he was wrong.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Lo riconoscerebbe subito, anche al buio.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He/She would recognize him immediately, even in the dark.

definitions.note: Second person plural (voi), conditional tense.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Riconoscereste la sua voce anche al telefono?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Would you recognize his voice even on the phone?

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mi riconosceresti anche dopo tanti anni?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Would you recognize me even after so many years?

definitions.note: Includes the object pronoun “ti” = “you” (informal singular).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Non riesco a riconoscerti con questi occhiali.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I can’t recognize you with these glasses.

definitions.note: Second-person plural form (“you all”); can be present tense (“you recognize”) or an imperative (“recognize!”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Riconoscete questa canzone?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Do you recognize this song?

definitions.note: Commonly means “you (singular) recognize” in the present; it can also be used as the singular command “recognize!”
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mi riconosci?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Do you recognize me?

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Il suo lavoro ha ricevuto molto riconoscimento.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: His work received a lot of recognition.

definitions.note: Commonly used in the phrase "documento di riconoscimento" for an official ID document.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Serve un documento di riconoscimento per entrare.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: You need an ID to enter.

definitions.note: feminine singular past participle (used with a feminine noun or as part of a compound tense/passive).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La sua esperienza è stata riconosciuta da tutti.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Her experience was recognized by everyone.

definitions.note: past participle (feminine plural) of "riconoscere"
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Le sue competenze sono state riconosciute da tutti.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Her skills were recognized by everyone.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Gli errori sono stati riconosciuti e corretti.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The mistakes were recognized and corrected.

definitions.note: past participle of "riconoscere"; often used with "avere" to form the past tense (e.g., "ho riconosciuto")
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho riconosciuto Marco in mezzo alla folla.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I recognized Marco in the middle of the crowd.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ti riconosco dalla voce.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I recognize you by your voice.

definitions.note: feminine singular form
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La torta è ricoperta di cioccolato.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The cake is covered with chocolate.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Luca ricorda il tuo nome.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Luca remembers your name.

definitions.note: (informal) imperative: used to tell one person “you” to remember something.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ricorda di spegnere la luce.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Remember to turn off the light.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Si ricordano sempre del tuo compleanno.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They always remember your birthday.

definitions.note: Often used with an indirect object (mi/ti/gli/le/ci/vi) + di.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mi ricordano di chiamare il medico.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They remind me to call the doctor.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Non riesco a ricordare il suo nome.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I can't remember his name.

definitions.note: Often used with an indirect object (e.g., "mi" = me): "Mi ricordi..." = "Remind me...".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mi puoi ricordare l'appuntamento di domani?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Can you remind me about tomorrow’s appointment?

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Puoi ricordarmi l’appuntamento di domani?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Can you remind me about tomorrow’s appointment?

definitions.note: Reflexive form; commonly used with “di” or “che” (e.g., ricordarsi di + noun/infinitive, ricordarsi che + clause).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mi ricordo di chiamarti domani.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I remember to call you tomorrow.

definitions.note: Often used with a following phrase like "di + infinitive" (to remind you to do something).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Devo ricordarti di pagare la bolletta oggi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have to remind you to pay the bill today.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: È bello ricordarti dopo tanti anni.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: It’s nice to remember you after so many years.

definitions.note: past participle (feminine singular) of ricordare; often used like an adjective
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: È una giornata che sarà ricordata a lungo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: It’s a day that will be remembered for a long time.

definitions.note: Second-person plural ("you all") present tense.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vi ricordate il suo nome?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Do you remember his name?

definitions.note: Plural command (to two or more people).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ricordate di chiudere la porta.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Remember to close the door.

definitions.note: Used as a command to more than one person (voi): “remember!” Often followed by “di” + infinitive.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ricordatevi di chiudere la porta.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Remember to close the door.

definitions.note: informal ("tu") command; often used with "di" + infinitive
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ricordati di chiudere la porta.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Remember to close the door.

definitions.note: Often used as a past participle (e.g., with avere) or as an adjective meaning “remembered.” It can be confused with English “recorded,” but it usually means “remembered.”
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho ricordato il tuo nome all’ultimo momento.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I remembered your name at the last moment.

definitions.note: Imperfect tense (past), used for ongoing/repeated remembering or background description.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Da bambino ricordava sempre il nome di tutti.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: As a child, he always remembered everyone's name.

definitions.note: Third-person singular future tense of "ricordare" (referring to "he/she" or "it").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Sono sicuro che ricorderà il tuo nome.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I'm sure he/she will remember your name.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Domani ricorderò di chiamarti.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Tomorrow I will remember to call you.

definitions.note: Informal ‘you’ (tu) form.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ti ricordi il suo nome?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Do you remember his name?

definitions.note: Plural of "ricordo".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho tanti ricordi di quel viaggio.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have many memories of that trip.

definitions.note: Present tense (noi).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ricordiamo sempre il tuo compleanno.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: We always remember your birthday.

definitions.note: Imperative / exhortation (noi): used to suggest doing something together.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ricordiamo di spegnere le luci prima di uscire.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Let’s remember to turn off the lights before leaving.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Non ricordo il suo nome.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I don’t remember his name.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho un ricordo bellissimo delle vacanze al mare.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have a wonderful memory of the vacation at the seaside.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ti ho comprato un piccolo ricordo di Roma.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I bought you a small souvenir from Rome.

definitions.note: Simple past (passato remoto), 3rd person singular; common in stories and written narratives.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Quando vide la foto, ricordò il suo primo viaggio in Italia.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: When he saw the photo, he remembered his first trip to Italy.

definitions.note: Often used with "a": "ricorrere a" = to resort to, to turn to (a person/solution)
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: In caso di emergenza, dobbiamo ricorrere a un medico.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: In an emergency, we have to resort to a doctor.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Questo problema tende a ricorrere ogni anno.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This problem tends to recur every year.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo il terremoto, hanno deciso di ricostruire il ponte.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After the earthquake, they decided to rebuild the bridge.

definitions.note: past participle used with feminine singular nouns (often with essere in passive or as an adjective)
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La casa è stata ricostruita dopo il terremoto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The house was rebuilt after the earthquake.

definitions.note: A fresh Italian whey cheese, often used in pasta dishes and desserts.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Per i cannoli uso la ricotta fresca.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: For cannoli I use fresh ricotta.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Quando l’ho visto inciampare, ho ridacchiato.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: When I saw him trip, I snickered.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Quando sentì la battuta, ridacchiò e si coprì la bocca.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: When he heard the joke, he chuckled and covered his mouth.

definitions.native: give me back, give it back to me
definitions.note: Informal command (tu form).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ridammi le chiavi, per favore.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Give me back the keys, please.

definitions.note: Imperative form (to more than one person): “give (it) back to me.”
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ridatemi le chiavi, per favore.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Give me back the keys, please.

definitions.note: False friend: it does not mean “rides” (as in traveling on a bike/horse).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Lui ride spesso quando guarda i video comici.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He often laughs when he watches funny videos.

definitions.note: Gerund: often means “while laughing” or “laughing as (someone does something else)”.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Camminava ridendo per strada.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He/She was walking down the street, laughing.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mi piace ridere con i miei amici.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I like to laugh with my friends.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Quando sentirà la notizia, riderà.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: When he hears the news, he will laugh.

definitions.note: Imperfetto (past habitual/ongoing): used for an action that was in progress or repeated in the past.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rideva mentre guardava il film.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He/She was laughing while watching the movie.

definitions.note: imperfect tense (ongoing or habitual past), 3rd person plural
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Quando lo hai detto, ridevano tutti.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: When you said it, they were all laughing.

definitions.note: Second-person singular (tu) form of “ridere”; informal “you.”
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Perché ridi?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Why are you laughing?

definitions.note: Used mainly with the subjunctive (e.g., after "che").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: È importante che lui ridia i soldi a sua sorella.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: It’s important that he give back the money to his sister.

definitions.note: feminine singular form (used with feminine nouns)
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Questa situazione è ridicola.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This situation is ridiculous.

definitions.note: feminine plural form
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Quelle scuse sono ridicole.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Those excuses are ridiculous.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Si è sentito ridicolizzato davanti a tutti.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He felt ridiculed in front of everyone.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Questa situazione è ridicola.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This situation is ridiculous.

definitions.note: Often used for repeating something someone else said; can sound a bit formal.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Puoi ridire quello che hai detto?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Can you repeat what you said?

definitions.note: Present tense, 1st person singular (io).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Quando sento una battuta divertente, rido.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: When I hear a funny joke, I laugh.

definitions.note: 3rd person plural present tense of "ridere".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ridono sempre quando racconti una storia.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They always laugh when you tell a story.

definitions.note: Past participle of "ridurre"; often used with auxiliary verbs (e.g., "ho ridotto", "è stato ridotto").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Abbiamo ridotto i costi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: We reduced the costs.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dobbiamo ridurre lo spreco di acqua.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: We have to reduce the waste of water.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Lei riempie la bottiglia d'acqua.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She fills the bottle with water.

definitions.note: Often used with "di" to say what something is filled with (e.g., "riempire il bicchiere di acqua").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Puoi riempire la bottiglia d’acqua?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Can you fill the bottle with water?

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho già riempito il modulo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’ve already filled out the form.

definitions.note: Past historic (passato remoto) form; common in narratives and written Italian.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Riempì il bicchiere d’acqua.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He/She filled the glass with water.

definitions.note: Used in the present subjunctive (often after expressions like "spero che…", "penso che…").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Spero che riesca a finire il lavoro oggi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I hope he/she can manage to finish the work today.

definitions.note: 3rd-person singular present of "riuscire"; often used with "a" + infinitive (e.g., "riesce a capire").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Non riesce a trovare le chiavi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He/She can’t manage to find the keys.

definitions.note: Second-person singular present tense of "riuscire" (used with "tu"). Often followed by "a" + infinitive.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Riesci a finire i compiti stasera?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Can you manage to finish your homework tonight?

definitions.note: First-person singular present tense of "riuscire"; often used with "a" + infinitive (e.g., "riesco a capire").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Non riesco a trovare le chiavi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I can’t manage to find the keys.

definitions.note: Present indicative, 3rd person plural of "riuscire".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Se studiano bene, riescono a superare l’esame.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: If they study well, they manage to pass the exam.

definitions.note: Often used as the present subjunctive (e.g., after expressions like “spero che…”). It can also be used as a formal command (Lei).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Spero che lo rifaccia domani.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I hope he/she does it again tomorrow.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Devo rifare il compito perché ho sbagliato.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have to redo the homework because I made a mistake.

definitions.note: Often used for films, songs, or other works (e.g. a movie remake).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Hanno deciso di rifare quel film in una nuova versione.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They decided to remake that movie in a new version.

definitions.native: to redo it, to do it again
definitions.note: Includes the direct object pronoun “la” (“it”, referring to something feminine or to an implied noun like “la cosa”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Devo rifarla da capo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have to redo it from scratch.

definitions.note: includes the direct object pronoun “lo” (“it”) attached to the verb.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Devo rifarlo da capo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have to do it again from scratch.

definitions.native: I will redo, I will do again
definitions.note: Future tense (1st person singular) of "rifare".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho sbagliato: rifarò il compito stasera.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I made a mistake: I will redo the assignment tonight.

definitions.note: Simple past (passato remoto) form, often used in written narratives and storytelling.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo l’errore, rifece tutto da capo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After the mistake, he redid everything from scratch.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Sto riferendo tutto al direttore.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m reporting everything to the manager.

definitions.note: Often used with "stare" (e.g., "mi stavo riferendo a...") to mean “I was referring to…”.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mi stavo riferendo a te.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I was referring to you.

definitions.note: plural of "riferimento"
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Nel documento ci sono molti riferimenti a studi recenti.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: In the document there are many references to recent studies.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Questo libro è un ottimo riferimento per studiare l’italiano.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This book is an excellent reference for studying Italian.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mi serve un punto di riferimento per orientarmi in questa città.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I need a point of reference to find my way around in this city.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Il testo si riferisce a un evento storico.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The text refers to a historical event.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Il medico riferisce che la paziente sta meglio.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The doctor reports that the patient is doing better.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho riferito tutto al direttore.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I reported/told everything to the director.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Questo termine è riferito al mondo della medicina.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This term refers to the world of medicine.

definitions.note: Past historic (passato remoto), 1st person singular: “I refused”.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rifiutai l'offerta perché non mi sembrava giusta.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I refused the offer because it didn’t seem right to me.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho rifiutato l’offerta perché non era conveniente.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I refused the offer because it wasn’t convenient.

definitions.native: to turn down (an invitation, an offer)
definitions.note: Common with offers, invitations, or proposals.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Lei ha rifiutato l’invito a cena.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She turned down the dinner invitation.

definitions.note: past historic (passato remoto), 3rd person plural
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rifiutarono l'offerta perché era troppo bassa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They refused the offer because it was too low.

definitions.note: feminine singular past participle of "rifiutare"; can also function as an adjective
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La mia richiesta è stata rifiutata.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: My request was refused.

definitions.note: 2nd person plural (voi) present tense; also the plural imperative can look the same in Italian.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Voi rifiutate l'invito.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: You refuse the invitation.

definitions.note: feminine plural past participle (used with feminine plural nouns, often in passive forms).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Sono state rifiutate le proposte.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The proposals were refused.

definitions.note: Often used like an adjective meaning something/someone that has been refused.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: I documenti sono stati rifiutati.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The documents were rejected.

definitions.note: past participle (commonly used with essere/avere to form compound tenses, or as an adjective)
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho rifiutato l'offerta.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I refused the offer.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Il suo rifiuto mi ha sorpreso.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: His refusal surprised me.

definitions.note: Often used in the plural (rifiuti) to mean garbage/trash.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Butta i rifiuti nel bidone.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Throw the trash in the bin.

definitions.note: Simple past (passato remoto), 3rd person singular: “he/she refused.”
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rifiutò l'offerta senza pensarci.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He refused the offer without thinking about it.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vedo il mio riflesso nello specchio.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I see my reflection in the mirror.

definitions.note: Often used for an automatic physical reaction (like a knee-jerk reflex).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Il medico controlla il riflesso del ginocchio.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The doctor checks the knee reflex.

definitions.note: Often used with “su” to mean “to think about” (e.g., riflettere su qualcosa).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Devo riflettere su questa decisione.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have to think about this decision.

definitions.note: Can be used as an informal singular command (“reflect!”) or as “you reflect/you think.”
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rifletti prima di parlare.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Think before you speak.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho riflettuto sulla tua proposta.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I thought about your proposal.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Il suono è riflettuto dalle pareti.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The sound is reflected by the walls.

definitions.note: Often used for a safe place to hide or be protected; also commonly used for a mountain hut (e.g., in the Alps).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Durante il temporale abbiamo trovato rifugio sotto un ponte.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: During the storm we found shelter under a bridge.

definitions.note: Plural of "riga".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Scrivi tre righe nel quaderno.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Write three lines in the notebook.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mi presti il righello per tracciare una linea dritta?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Can you lend me the ruler to draw a straight line?

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Questo problema riguarda tutti.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This problem concerns everyone.

definitions.note: Often used as an informal (tu) command.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Riguarda questa foto!
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Look at this photo!

definitions.note: Often used in the phrase “riguardo a …” (= “about …”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho una domanda riguardo al tuo progetto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have a question about your project.

definitions.note: Often used in expressions like “avere riguardo per” (to have respect/consideration for) and “con riguardo a” (with regard to).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho grande riguardo per i tuoi genitori.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have great respect for your parents.

definitions.note: Often used for officially giving something out (e.g., a document, a statement, an app update).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: L’ufficio rilascia un nuovo passaporto in due settimane.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The office issues a new passport in two weeks.

definitions.note: Past participle of "rilasciare"; often used with an auxiliary (e.g., "ho rilasciato", "è stato rilasciato").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho rilasciato un'intervista ieri.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I gave an interview yesterday.

definitions.note: gerund form (used like “-ing” in English), often with “stare” to talk about something happening now
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mi sto rilassando dopo il lavoro.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m relaxing after work.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Questa musica è molto rilassante.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This music is very relaxing.

definitions.note: Often used reflexively: "rilassarsi" = to relax (oneself). It can also mean "to loosen" (e.g., muscles).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo il lavoro mi piace rilassare i muscoli con un bagno caldo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After work I like to relax my muscles with a hot bath.

definitions.note: Includes the pronoun "mi" (“myself/me”): literally “to relax myself,” often just “to relax.”
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Voglio rilassarmi stasera.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I want to relax tonight.

definitions.note: Reflexive verb (used with a reflexive pronoun: mi/ti/si/ci/vi/si).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo il lavoro mi rilasso sul divano.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After work I relax on the couch.

definitions.note: feminine singular form
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo la vacanza mi sento più rilassata.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After the vacation I feel more relaxed.

definitions.note: Informal plural (voi) imperative with reflexive pronoun “vi” = “relax (yourselves),” said to more than one person.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rilassatevi, va tutto bene.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Relax, everything is fine.

definitions.note: informal singular command ("tu"); reflexive form meaning "relax yourself"
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rilassati, va tutto bene.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Relax, everything is fine.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Oggi sono molto rilassato.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Today I am very relaxed.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Oggi mi sento rilassato.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Today I feel relaxed.

definitions.note: Often used to describe a person's attitude or personality.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Lui è molto rilassato con i colleghi.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He is very laid-back with his coworkers.

definitions.note: Present subjunctive form of "rilassare", often used after expressions like "spero che" (I hope that) or "è meglio che" (it’s better that).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Spero che tu ti rilassi un po' questo weekend.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I hope you relax a bit this weekend.

definitions.note: simple past (passato remoto), 3rd person singular
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo il viaggio, si rilassò subito.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After the trip, he/she relaxed right away.

definitions.note: past participle of "rileggere"
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho riletto l’email due volte.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I reread the email twice.

definitions.note: Past participle of "rilevare"; often used with "avere" to mean noticing/discovering something (e.g., an error or a problem).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Abbiamo rilevato un errore nel documento.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: We detected an error in the document.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Era riluttante ad accettare l’offerta.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He was reluctant to accept the offer.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ha accettato il lavoro con riluttanza.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He accepted the job reluctantly.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dobbiamo rimandare la riunione a domani.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: We have to postpone the meeting until tomorrow.

definitions.note: Often used for returning something (e.g., a product) to the sender/shop.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Se non ti piace, puoi rimandare il prodotto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: If you don’t like it, you can send the product back.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La riunione è stata rimandata a domani.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The meeting was postponed until tomorrow.

definitions.note: Commonly used about a student being made to repeat an exam or not passing a subject.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Giulia è stata rimandata in matematica.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Giulia failed math.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho rimandato la riunione a domani.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I postponed the meeting until tomorrow.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Mi hanno rimandato a casa perché stavo male.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They sent me home because I felt sick.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A causa della pioggia, rimandò la partita.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Because of the rain, he/she postponed the match.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Il professore rimandò lo studente in classe.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The teacher sent the student back to class.

definitions.note: Present tense form of "rimanere"; used for "he/she/it stays" or "it remains" depending on context.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Lui rimane a casa stasera.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He stays home tonight.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Preferisco rimanere a casa stasera.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I prefer to stay at home tonight.

definitions.note: 2nd-person plural present indicative ("you" plural). Also used as the polite form "you" (Lei) in some regional/older usage, but most commonly it’s plural.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rimanete qui, per favore.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Stay here, please.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo la lezione, rimaneva a scuola per studiare.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After the lesson, he/she stayed at school to study.

definitions.note: Used in the present subjunctive (often after “che”) and also as a formal command (Lei).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Spero che rimanga qui fino a domani.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I hope that you stay here until tomorrow.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rimango a casa stasera.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m staying at home tonight.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo la festa, rimangono solo due bottiglie d’acqua.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After the party, only two bottles of water are left.

definitions.note: 2nd-person singular (tu) form; can mean “you stay/are staying” or be used as an imperative (“stay!”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rimani qui, per favore.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Stay here, please.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rimaniamo qui fino alle cinque.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: We stay here until five.

definitions.native: you will stay, you will remain
definitions.note: Second-person singular (tu) future tense of "rimanere".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rimarrai qui fino a domani?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Will you stay here until tomorrow?

definitions.note: second-person plural future tense ("you all" / "you" plural)
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Se aspettate qui, rimarrete al caldo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: If you wait here, you will stay warm.

definitions.note: Future tense (3rd person singular) of "rimanere".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La porta rimarrà chiusa fino a domani.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The door will remain closed until tomorrow.

definitions.native: I will stay, I will remain
definitions.note: first person singular ("I") in the simple future.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rimarrò a casa stasera.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I will stay at home tonight.

definitions.note: Past historic (passato remoto) form of "rimanere"; common in writing and storytelling.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo la notizia, rimase in silenzio.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After the news, he remained silent.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rimasero in silenzio per qualche minuto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They remained silent for a few minutes.

definitions.note: past historic (passato remoto) form of “rimanere”; common in narratives and in some regions
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Rimasi a casa tutta la sera.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I stayed at home all evening.

definitions.note: feminine singular past participle of "rimanere" (used with essere and agrees with the subject)

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Can you put the book back on the table, please?

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Put the books back on the shelf, please.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Puoi rimuovere questa app dal telefono?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Can you remove this app from your phone?

definitions.note: Often the passato remoto (historic past) of "rinchiudere" (3rd person singular: he/she/it shut/locked up).

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He/She shut the door and left.

definitions.note: Second person singular (tu) present indicative of “ringraziare”.

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He thanks the teacher for the help.

definitions.note: past historic (passato remoto), 1st person singular
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ti ringraziai per il tuo aiuto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I thanked you for your help.

definitions.note: Often used in the plural: “ringraziamenti” = “thanks.”
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Grazie per il tuo aiuto: ti devo un ringraziamento.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Thanks for your help: I owe you a thank-you.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vorrei ringraziarti per il tuo aiuto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’d like to thank you for your help.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vorrei ringraziarla per il suo aiuto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I would like to thank you for your help.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Voglio ringraziarla per l'aiuto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I want to thank her for the help.

definitions.note: Formal, polite form (with the object pronoun La, often written with a capital L).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Desidero ringraziarla per la sua disponibilità.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I would like to thank you for your availability.

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I want to thank them for the help.

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Do you want to thank me for the help?

definitions.note: direct object pronoun “ti” attached to the infinitive (ringraziare + ti)
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vorrei ringraziarti per il tuo aiuto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I would like to thank you for your help.

definitions.native: to thank you (plural), to thank you (formal)

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I wanted to thank you for the help.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ti ho ringraziato per l’aiuto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I thanked you for the help.

definitions.note: First-person singular present tense: “I thank” / “I’m thanking”.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ti ringrazio per l’aiuto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Thank you for the help.

definitions.note: Simple past (passato remoto), third-person singular: “he/she thanked.”

definitions.note: Used for renewing things like a contract, subscription, passport, or documents; also for updating something (e.g., a website).

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have to renew my passport before the trip.

definitions.note: Often used with things like a look, a memory, or an idea (in the sense of making it feel new again).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Una doccia mi ha rinnovato dopo la corsa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: A shower refreshed me after the run.

definitions.note: Often used with “a” + noun/verb (e.g., “rinunciare a qualcosa/ a fare qualcosa”).

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I decided to give up on the trip.

definitions.note: Used especially with “a” (e.g., “rinunciare al lavoro” = resign from a job).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ha rinunciato al lavoro la settimana scorsa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He resigned from his job last week.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Il portafoglio è stato rinvenuto dalla polizia.

definitions.native: tidy up, put back in order

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Devo riordinare la camera prima di uscire.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Sto riparando la bici.

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have to fix it today.

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have to fix it before tomorrow.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ripari la bici oggi?

definitions.note: Used as the formal (Lei) command (“Repeat.”) and also as the present subjunctive (e.g. “that he/she/you-formal repeat”).

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Marco riporta il libro in biblioteca.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La lezione riprenderà alle tre.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The lesson will resume at three.

definitions.native: will take back, will pick up again

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Tomorrow he/she will take back the book that he/she lent me.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo la pausa, riprendo a lavorare.

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I pick up the book from the shelf.

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I scold my son when he doesn’t tell the truth.

definitions.note: Past historic (passato remoto) form; common in written narratives, less in everyday speech.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo la pausa, riprese a parlare con calma.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After the break, he/she resumed speaking calmly.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dopo la pausa, ho ripreso il lavoro.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: La sua risata era contagiosa.

definitions.note: Can be used for “he/she/it warms up/heats up” (present tense). It can also be an imperative meaning “warm up!” depending on context.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ho bevuto una tisana riscaldata.
